Kerala Congress MLA Ramya Haridas and Workers Booked After Scuffle

Police in Keralam have registered a case against Congress MLA Ramya Haridas and 15 party workers following a violent scuffle. Allegations and counter-allegations of mutual assault have been made by both groups. Seven Congress workers were booked in connection with the incident. Ramya Haridas was admitted to a hospital in Thiruvananthapuram after the scuffle.
